A '''Dark Jedi''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitive]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], having fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]]. They served the forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and commanded at least one [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]]. At some point during their career, the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] gave into their anger and [[Death/Legends|murdered]] one of their subordinate [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] with their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. The Dark Jedi was light-skinned and had [[Color/Legends|black]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]], and also wore blue [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] with a hooded [[Cloak/Legends|cloak]]. They used a lightsaber with a yellow [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]].<ref name="JATM" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dark Jedi appeared in an image created for the ''[[Jedi Academy Training Manual]]'', a resource guide for the ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''. He was drawn by [[Francis Tsai]].
